errors.text: The fracture-morphology assignment is reversed: the HPHT-treated material should exhibit distributed or isolated microcracks, whereas elongated interfacial cracks characterize the brittle baseline.
The predicted outcome omits the central quantitative result of approximately 1150 MPa strength and 36% tensile elongation, both nearly doubled relative to the relevant baseline.

The cited evidence does not substantiate the proposed HPHT transformation, coherent interfaces, or GND convergence; most evidence concerns a different AlCoCrFeNi2.1 composition, and one citation concerns molten-salt corrosion.
The stated baseline properties of approximately 944 MPa and 25.6% elongation are unsupported by the supplied evidence and inconsistent with the target's nearly 100% HPHT enhancement.
